name: corneizer
description: Skills I use every day, kept where they can be installed rather than copied.

plugins.name: nuclock
plugins.description: Working in the nuclock tracker: plan a backlog into a queue, see what is next and what is blocked, take a task from start to done, and keep the timer honest. Ships hooks that warn and never write time.

plugins.name: coderabbit
plugins.description: Reviewing with CodeRabbit as an operating procedure: which surface to spend, how the hourly allowances behave, how to prove a head is really reviewed, and why a finding is a sample of a class rather than a single site.

plugins.name: vet
plugins.description: A full review pass for GitLab merge requests and GitHub pull requests: findings verified and reproduced by a command before anyone reads them, a mutation pass for untested behaviour, and the result staged as private drafts that are published only on your word.
